# Help with Glim / 使用帮助

Choose the question closest to your task. English and Chinese are welcome.

| What you need | Where to go |
| --- | --- |
| Find a use for Glim | [Topics](../docs/topics.md) |
| Install or open your first files | [Installation](../README.md#download) · [User guide](../docs/user-guide.md) |
| Understand editing, previews or recovery | [Common questions](../docs/faq.md) |
| Check a file format | [Compatibility](../docs/file-format-support.md) |
| Understand network access and local records | [Privacy](../docs/privacy.md) |
| Ask a question or discuss an idea | [Discussions](https://github.com/glimapp/glim/discussions) |
| Report a bug or request a capability | [Issue forms](https://github.com/glimapp/glim/issues/new/choose) |
| Report a vulnerability privately | [Security policy](../SECURITY.md) |

For a report, include what you were trying to do, your version, Mac type and a sanitized example where useful. As a volunteer project, Glim has no support SLA or fixed response time.

## 中文说明

先按自己的问题找到入口：[场景专题](../docs/topics.zh-CN.md)、[安装](../README.zh-CN.md#下载与安装)、[使用指南](../docs/user-guide.zh-CN.md)、[常见问题](../docs/faq.zh-CN.md)、[格式兼容](../docs/file-format-support.zh-CN.md)、[隐私](../docs/privacy.zh-CN.md)。

交流想法使用 Discussions，反馈问题或提出功能需求使用 Issue 表单。说明你正在做什么、版本、Mac 类型，必要时提供脱敏样例。安全漏洞请私密报告。项目由志愿者维护，没有固定响应时间承诺。
